scope: Compatibility of already exposed candidate extensions, not adoption of new public functions. Source content hash records retrieved master content; network source updates are not automatic contract updates.

sources.symbols: Standard Environment, String Functions, Bytes Functions

decisions.case: Only ASCII A-Z/a-z is case-mapped; non-ASCII code points remain unchanged.
decisions.search: Unicode code-point offsets; negative offsets error, empty search clamps to length, non-empty search at/past length returns -1.
decisions.substring: Unicode code-point half-open range; negative, reversed or out-of-range bounds error.
decisions.split: Empty separator splits Unicode code points. Existing limit semantics retained.
decisions.trim: Go Unicode White_Space; U+0085 included, U+FEFF and U+200B excluded.
decisions.bytesJson: Package extension bug fix only: browser TextDecoder UTF-8 decoding before JSON.parse. No new JSON numeric, scalar or invalid UTF-8 policy.
